signals.title: Holders ~29% underwater — and still not selling
signals.detail: MVRV 0.71: price is 29% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.518). Yet 61% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving. MVRV has risen 0.67→0.71 over ~30d.
signals.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
signals.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".
